summary: Inverted orchestrator enablement opt-IN -> opt-OUT (default-ON). Marker repurposed .on -> .off across all hooks: gate now `[ -f $DIR/$SID.off ] && exit 0`. Files: classify.sh (MARK->.off, swapped on/off branches so 'orch off' creates marker / 'orch on' removes it, comment+messages updated), suggest-links.sh, subagent-start.sh, subagent-stop.sh, post-agent.sh, orch-gate.sh (edited LAST), README.md. settings.sample.json/hooks.json had no opt-in wording (JSON, no relevant comment). Self-test 6/6 pass: (1) no .off+no claim->DENY exit2 [new behavior]; (2) .off present->exit0; (3) ORCH_GATE_OFF=1->exit0; (4) claimed in_progress session->exit0; (5) classify 'orch off'->creates .off; (6) classify 'orch on'->removes .off. smoke.sh 13/13 pass. No live settings.json change; temp markers cleaned; live daemon up; my claim intact (proved gate allows claimed session mid-edit). CROSS-WORKSPACE: these shared ~/.claude hooks now make orchestrator default-ON for ANY workspace wiring them; the gate blocks un-claimed Write|Edit everywhere. Escapes: `orch off` (per conversation) or ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 (per edit). Stale .on markers now inert/harmless; sessions/ was empty, no cleanup needed.
